source_prompt: the memory game should be fully playable from start to win

checks.statement: Before clicking Start, all cards are face down.
Clicking Start begins the game: status changes and cards become clickable.
After the game has started, clicking a face-down card flips it face up.
A non-matching pair flips back face down within roughly 1.5s.
Restart resets score and board to the initial pre-start state.
